KISWAHILI — GENERAL ASSESSMENT #2
====

GRADE: Grade 5
SUBJECT: KISWAHILI
TIME ALLOWED: 45 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 30
EXAM BODY: KPSEA

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----

   A. Copy random text without understanding Sarufi 1.4.2 Aina za nomino Nomino za kawaida.
   B. Use insults to “practise” Sarufi 1.4.2 Aina za nomino Nomino za kawaida.
   C. Avoid reading anything related to Sarufi 1.4.2 Aina za nomino Nomino za kawaida.
   D. Use clear examples, correct form, and a short local context for Sarufi 1.4.2 Aina za nomino Nomino za kawaida.

2. Wingi wa “mtoto” ni: (1 mark)
